lines.text: This re-exhibition of the grotto at the Odesa National Fine Arts Museum is supported by the Partnership Fund for a Resilient Ukraine (PFRU), funded by aid from the governments of Canada, Estonia, Finland, Norway, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
